title: sctrap: trap frequencies of magnetically levitated particles over arbitrary superconductor geometries
description: sctrap computes the equilibrium position, levitation height and the five trap frequencies (three translational, two librational) of a magnetic dipole levitated above an arbitrary superconductor geometry, directly from a gmsh mesh. It solves the magnetic-scalar-potential Laplace problem on the air domain with a Meissner (Neumann) condition on the superconductor surface using scikit-fem, in pure Python with no conda, MPI or PETSc dependency. Results are validated against analytic image-dipole limits and against published levitation experiments.
